name: Westfield Topanga
demographics: Westfield Topanga serves the affluent West San Fernando Valley, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from Canoga Park, Woodland Hills, and Calabasas. The trade area demographics skew toward households earning $75,000-$150,000 annually, with a mix of young families, established professionals aged 25-54, and empty nesters seeking quality retail and dining experiences. Shoppers demonstrate preferences for both mainstream fashion brands and upscale retailers, with strong weekday lunch traffic from nearby office workers and weekend family visits for combined shopping and entertainment outings.
description: Westfield Topanga is a premier shopping destination in Canoga Park featuring world-class retail brands, dining, and entertainment experiences. As part of the globally recognized Westfield portfolio, the center offers an exceptional mix of local and international retailers with convenient amenities including Smart Parking and click-and-collect services. The mall serves as a dynamic entertainment destination where visitors can shop, dine, and socialize in a beautifully designed environment.
summary: Westfield Topanga is a major regional shopping center in the San Fernando Valley offering a comprehensive retail experience with global brands, diverse dining options, and modern shopping amenities. The center positions itself as more than just a mall, serving as a community hub for entertainment, events, and social gatherings.
